items.title: 27.4.4 Lipids ki ghizai aur hayatiyati ahmiyat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the importance of lipids with Quick Check 27.3 answered (PDF 171-172).

blocks.text: Lipids ka aik bara kaam jaandaron mein energy ka asal zakheera (storage) hona hai. Yeh fi gram carbohydrates se zyada energy dete hain, kyun ke carbon dioxide aur paani mein oxidise hone par in ki caloric value (har gram se milne wali energy) zyada hoti hai.

Lipids charbi mein ghulne wale vitamins (A, D, E aur K) ke liye solvent ka kaam karte hain: yeh in vitamins ko aanton ke cells mein jazb hone aur phir khoon tak pohanchne mein madad dete hain. Hum aisi khurak kha kar apni vitamin ki zaroorat poori kar sakte hain jis mein yeh vitamins hon, aur inhein thori si sehatmand charbi ke saath khana chahiye. Kitab ke mutabiq fats non-polar hone ki wajah se jism ko paani, garmi aur bijli se insulation (bachao) dete hain; asal mein jild ke neeche charbi ki teh sab se zyada jism ki garmi ko bahar nikalne se rokti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Polar bear, reptiles aur amphibians jaise jaanwar hibernation (sardiyon ki lambi neend) ke liye zaid charbi jama karte hain. Hibernation mein jaanwar khurak ki kami ke dino mein energy bachane ke liye apna metabolism, jism ka temperature, dil ki dharkan aur saans bohat kam kar dete hain. Charbi glycogen se zyada gathi (concentrated) energy hai, is liye jaanwar bohat kam energy kharch karte hue jama charbi ko achhi tarah use kar lete hain.

blocks.prompt: a) Lipids paani mein kyun nahi ghulte?
blocks.explanation: In ki lambi hydrocarbon zanjeerein non-polar (hydrophobic) hain aur paani ke molecules se hydrogen bonds nahi bana saktin.

blocks.prompt: b) Insani jism mein lipids ke teen bare kaam kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Koi teen: energy ka zakheera; insulation aur aaza ki hifazat; cell membranes ka hissa (phospholipids); charbi mein ghulne wale vitamins ka solvent; hormones (steroids).

blocks.prompt: c) Kis qism ke lipids mein fatty acids nahi hote? Misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: Steroids (jaise cholesterol) aur terpenes (jaise limonene) mein fatty acids nahi hote. Triglycerides (fats aur oils), waxes aur phospholipids mein fatty acids hote hain.

blocks.prompt: d) Nabati teil aur banaspati ghee dono triglycerides hain. Dono ki banawat mein bara farq kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Nabati teil mein zyada tar unsaturated fatty acids (C=C wale) hain, is liye woh maaye hai; banaspati ghee teil ki hydrogenation (double bonds par hydrogen jorna) se banta hai, is liye is ke fatty acids zyada tar saturated hain aur yeh thos hai.

items: Lipids: sab se zyada energy wala zakheera (carbohydrates se zyada fi gram).
Vitamins A, D, E, K ke solvent; insulation.
Hibernation wale jaanwar jama charbi par guzara karte hain.
